reviews.comment: Best motherboard I ever gotten! Wont need to upgrade for a long time
reviews.author: Aaron

reviews.title: Did not come with everything
reviews.comment: I love this board, but it did not come with the integrated wifi installment. I at first was not aware that it came with one, but after reading the manual I learned that mine is missing. If I could get some support on this that would be great. Leaving 2 stars for attention and will change my review when helped out but other than my own issue I think this board is fantastic !
reviews.author: Trey
